#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Restore VGGT environment from Drive cache.
# Usage on fresh Colab session with GPU runtime:
#   bash /content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/cache/new_f_vggt/restore.sh
set -e
CACHE=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/cache/new_f_vggt

if [ ! -d /content/vggt-repo ]; then
  echo '[restore] untar vggt-repo...'
  zstd -d -c $CACHE/vggt-repo.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C /content/

    zstd -d -c $CACHE/hf_vggt_cache.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C $HOME/.cache/huggingface/hub/
  fi

RESTORE_EOF

Saves ~10 min install + 4 GB checkpoint download.'}; out = '$CACHE/cache_done_v1.json'; open(out, 'w').write(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)); print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))"; df -h /content/drive 2>&1 | head -3; ls -lah "$CACHE"; echo "[new-f-tar] done $(date -u)"
